beats.event: Thebes under plague; king Oedipus resolves to find the cause
Creon returns from Delphi: Laius's murderer still pollutes the city
Oedipus vows to find and curse the killer
Tiresias summoned; accuses Oedipus himself of the murder
Oedipus dismisses the prophet; suspects a plot with Creon
Jocasta tells of Laius killed at a fork in the road
Oedipus recognizes his own violent crossroads encounter
Corinth messenger: Polybus is dead; Oedipus briefly relieved
Messenger reveals: Merope is not his true mother
The old shepherd is summoned; Jocasta begs him to stop asking
Shepherd confesses: the exposed child was Laius and Jocasta's son
Oedipus grasps he killed his father and married his mother
Jocasta hangs herself in the bedchamber
Oedipus gouges out his own eyes with her gold pins
Blinded Oedipus begs Creon for exile from Thebes
